candidate_proposition: If users respond to truthful uncertainty disclosure by allocating more trials to the most legible provider, improved transparency can reduce population-wide evidence about less legible competitors despite increasing each disclosed estimate’s accuracy.
strongest_interpretation: When truthful uncertainty disclosure attracts finite trials to the most legible provider, estimate accuracy can improve within that provider while cross-provider discrimination deteriorates. An independent audition budget may repair the latter at fixed disclosure.
